summary: S&T Bancorp filed an 8-K to announce its board approved a $0.37 per share quarterly cash dividend, a $0.01 increase (2.78%) from the prior quarter and $0.03 (8.82%) from the year-ago period. The dividend yields 3.33% based on the April 28 closing price of $44.43. Payable May 28, 2026, to holders of record on May 14, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend increase, not a special situation involving a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. Watch for continued dividend growth as a sign of capital management discipline.
